note: Jakarta hybrid scene. Dina edits this by hand or approves changes from the Coach's desk. Only list dates you have seen on the organiser's own page; leave `date` empty and use `when` for anything not yet confirmed. `type`: race | sim | brand | venue. `mode`: race | watch | both.

items.name: AirAsia HYROX Jakarta
items.blurb: The home race. Indonesia's first HYROX drew ~11,200 athletes to NICE, PIK2 in June 2026 — the biggest Asia-Pacific debut so far. Next edition expected mid-2027; the countdown starts the day it's confirmed.

items.name: Jakarta Hybrid Race — Indonesia Sports Summit 2026
items.blurb: Half-simulation format: run plus all eight stations (SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpee broad jump, row, farmers carry, sandbag lunges, wall balls) on official Centr × HYROX kit. Doubles Women/Men, Doubles Pro and Relay, plus Hybrid Training sessions for adults and kids. Free to watch as part of the Summit.
items.venue: Jakarta International Convention Center (JICC), GBK Hall A

items.name: PUMA Road to HYROX Jakarta
items.blurb: PUMA (HYROX global partner) ran a ~3-month build-up before the 2026 race: open selection for a PUMA HYROX Team, structured sessions with PUMA Indonesia athletes and full race simulations at 20FIT Arena. Expect it to return ahead of the 2027 race — watch PUMA Indonesia's IG for the selection call.
items.when: Returned each race season; 2027 dates TBC

items.name: 20FIT Arena — HYROX Training Club
items.blurb: Jakarta's purpose-built HYROX floor: 2,400 m², eight competition-standard stations on Centr and Concept2 kit, Foundation/Engine/Complete classes and bookable full race simulations. The default place to run a timed sim before an away race.
items.venue: Menteng Prada, Jl. Pegangsaan Timur No.15A, Menteng

items.name: Fitopia Hybrid Sport Arena — Meruya
items.blurb: West Jakarta's first dedicated eight-station hybrid arena inside a 24-hour gym, announced for Q4 2026. Useful for athletes west of the city who currently cross town for sled work.

items.name: Roxjaya Warriors squad sim
items.blurb: Dina's own timed simulation for Warriors — full or half race, splits captured for the databank, coaching notes after. Small groups; program members first. Dates land on the Events page and in the digest.
